scope: Follow-up only. No changes to these consumers in PR117 numeric repair. Actual Java Formatter examples using exact source XML templates and representative arguments; no installed UI claim.

records.impact: Oversize rejection warning retains decimal-dot requested and allowed MP values in a Brazilian Portuguese sentence; admission math is unaffected.
records.root_formatted_example: 1500 × 1500 pixels (2.25 MP) excedem o limite seguro de edição atual de 1.50 MP. O AN Paint mantém a imagem completa na memória e reserva espaço para transformações e seleções. A memória disponível determina esse limite. A operação foi interrompida antes de alocar o bitmap grande demais. Nenhum redimensionamento automático foi aplicado.

records.impact: New/resize/canvas-size dialog budget caption retains decimal-dot MP values.

Populated recent-colour accessibility caption uses ROOT index digits while empty-cell caption uses localized ui formatting. Hex identifier must remain unchanged.

records.impact: Low-zoom label and its consumers retain decimal-dot percentage. The >=10% integer branch also uses unlocalized string interpolation.
records.source_line: fun zoomLabel(): String = if (zoom >= .1f) "${(zoom * 100).roundToInt()}%" else String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.2f%%", zoom * 100)

intentional_invariants: DimensionControls.kt:59, ImageCropDialog.kt:82 and NormalizeImagesDialog.kt:35 serialize editable numeric fields with decimal dots accepted by existing parsers; keep separate from display labels.
Colour hex values use ASCII hexadecimal syntax; they must not be localized as decimal digits.
Identifiers, sort keys and text codec syntax using Locale.ROOT are machine semantics, not locale display defects.
